entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment: Foodstuffs for human and animal consumption, live animals, seeds, plants, additives normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs. Excl. beverages and water, this does not apply to selected drinks (milk and liquid milk products, plant-based milk alternatives, even if they contain added sugar or other sweetener, additive or other food, provided they retain the essential character of such beverages).
